tokens.name: chrome-top
tokens.usage: Top stop of the brushed gradient on the title bar, toolbar and status bar.

tokens.name: chrome
tokens.usage: Flat window chrome and the cover ground. ink and ink-muted read on it.

tokens.name: chrome-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom stop of the brushed gradient; always paired with chrome-top.

tokens.name: chrome-edge
tokens.usage: 1px line under the toolbar, above the status bar and right of the sidebar.

tokens.name: engrave
tokens.usage: 1px text-shadow under chrome text for the engraved look (0 1px 0). Never a fill.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and glyphs on chrome, chrome-top, chrome-bottom, control-top/bottom, surface and surface-alt.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and placeholders on chrome, chrome-top, chrome-bottom, surface and surface-alt.

tokens.name: bezel
tokens.usage: 1px border of every control (buttons, segments, fields, transport discs). 3:1 on the chrome gradient.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Decorative separators between list column headers. Carries no meaning.

tokens.name: control-top
tokens.usage: Top stop of glossy silver controls: Button, segments, transport discs, column headers.

tokens.name: control-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom stop of glossy silver controls; reversed with control-top while pressed.

tokens.name: pressed-top
tokens.usage: Top stop of a selected segment and the hidden-answer sleeve.

tokens.name: pressed-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom stop of a selected segment and the hidden-answer sleeve.

tokens.name: on-pressed
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on pressed-top / pressed-bottom.

tokens.name: source-bg
tokens.usage: Blue-gray sidebar (SourceList, NowPlaying caption).

tokens.name: source-heading
tokens.usage: Uppercase section headings and captions on source-bg.

tokens.name: source-ink
tokens.usage: Item labels on source-bg.

tokens.name: source-icon
tokens.usage: Item glyphs on source-bg (3:1 or better).

tokens.name: select-top
tokens.usage: Top stop of the selection gradient: chosen source item, your row in a list.

tokens.name: select-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom stop of the selection gradient; also the count-badge text on a selected row.

tokens.name: on-select
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on select-top / select-bottom.

tokens.name: count-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of count pills in the sidebar and neutral badges.

tokens.name: on-count
tokens.usage: Text on count-bg.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: List-view rows and text fields.

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: Zebra stripe on every second list row.

tokens.name: sort-top
tokens.usage: Top stop of the sorted column header in a list; ink reads on it.

tokens.name: sort-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom stop of the sorted column header.

tokens.name: lcd-bg
tokens.usage: The LCD status panel. Only lcd-ink, lcd-muted and lcd-fill go on it.

tokens.name: lcd-ink
tokens.usage: LCD title line, times and progress outline on lcd-bg.

tokens.name: lcd-muted
tokens.usage: LCD second line and side glyphs on lcd-bg.

tokens.name: lcd-fill
tokens.usage: Elapsed part of the LCD progress bar.

tokens.name: lcd-bezel
tokens.usage: 1px frame around the LCD.

tokens.name: grid-bg
tokens.usage: The dark album-art wall. Dark in both themes so covers glow.

tokens.name: grid-ink
tokens.usage: Tile titles and headings on grid-bg; inner ring of selected tiles.

tokens.name: grid-muted
tokens.usage: Tile subtitles (artist) and helper text on grid-bg.

tokens.name: aqua
tokens.usage: The brand blue: primary Button, selected answer ring, the record label. on-aqua reads on it.

tokens.name: aqua-hi
tokens.usage: Gloss stop at the top of the primary Button. Never under text on its own.

tokens.name: aqua-edge
tokens.usage: Border of the primary Button and its pressed bottom stop.

tokens.name: on-aqua
tokens.usage: Text on aqua.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus color, used inset on rows and inside shadow-focus.

tokens.name: toggle-on
tokens.usage: Glyph of a toggled-on bar button (repeat, shuffle) on the control gradient.

tokens.name: correct
tokens.usage: Right answer: badge fill and tile ring. Lighter than wrong by 3:1, always paired with a check and the word.

tokens.name: on-correct
tokens.usage: Text and glyph on correct.

tokens.name: wrong
tokens.usage: Wrong answer: badge fill and tile ring. Always paired with a cross and the word.

tokens.name: on-wrong
tokens.usage: Text and glyph on wrong.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: First place and streaks: the trophy badge.

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: Text and glyph on gold.

tokens.name: dot-close
tokens.usage: Leave-room window dot.

tokens.name: dot-minimize
tokens.usage: Second window dot (decorative).

tokens.name: dot-zoom
tokens.usage: Third window dot (decorative).

families.ui: "Lucida Grande", "Lucida Sans Unicode", "Lucida Sans", Geneva, Verdana, sans-serif

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Status bar, column headers, LCD second line, artist names.

styles.name: label-strong
styles.usage: Segments, tile titles, Now Playing header.

styles.name: lcd-time
styles.usage: LCD elapsed / remaining, tabular figures; badges.

styles.name: answer
styles.usage: The large answer field and large buttons.

styles.name: question
styles.usage: The round prompt above the album grid, grid-ink on grid-bg.

styles.name: score
styles.usage: Final scores and the podium; tabular figures.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls; status bar padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Toolbar side padding; gap between toolbar groups.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Album grid padding and column gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Space above and below the round prompt.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Album art corners, LCD progress track.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Segmented control, bar buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: The window and the LCD.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, search and answer fields, badges, count pills.

tokens.name: shadow-window
tokens.usage: The outer window.

tokens.name: shadow-gloss
tokens.usage: Resting glossy controls: top highlight plus a 1px lift.

tokens.name: shadow-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed controls and the selected segment.

tokens.name: shadow-lcd
tokens.usage: The recessed LCD.

tokens.name: shadow-field
tokens.usage: Recessed text fields and slider tracks.

tokens.name: shadow-art
tokens.usage: Album art lifting off grid-bg.

tokens.name: shadow-dot
tokens.usage: Window dots.

tokens.name: shadow-focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every control. The two rings keep it visible on chrome and on grid-bg.

tokens.name: titlebar-h
tokens.usage: Title bar row.

tokens.name: toolbar-h
tokens.usage: Toolbar row under the title bar.

tokens.name: statusbar-h
tokens.usage: Bottom status bar.

tokens.name: sidebar-w
tokens.usage: Source list and Now Playing width.

tokens.name: row-h
tokens.usage: Source items and list rows.

tokens.name: control-h
tokens.usage: Buttons, segments and the search field.

tokens.name: transport-md
tokens.usage: Previous / next transport discs.

tokens.name: transport-lg
tokens.usage: Play / pause transport disc.

tokens.name: lcd-h
tokens.usage: LCD height.

tokens.name: art-md
tokens.usage: Album tile art in the grid.
